name: Cali Plates Hash
description:
Cali Plates Hash
is a premium, solventless dry sift concentrate mechanically separated and pressed into dense, crystalline plates that break with a satisfying snap. Zero solvents, zero additives,  just pure trichome kief refined into a firm, golden-to-amber slab ideal for precise shaving, clean dosing, and low-temp melting. The plate format protects terpene integrity while delivering the granular purity of elite dry sift in a stable, collector-friendly form. Lab-tested for potency, terpenes, and contaminants, and shipped discreetly across the EU in cold-chain-protected, odor-proof packaging.

name: Commercial Hash
description:
Commercial Hash
is a premium, consistently graded resin engineered for everyday connoisseurs who demand reliable potency without compromise. Produced through refined mechanical separation and careful curing, it delivers a balanced, resin-rich profile with smooth, earthy terpenes and dependable batch-to-batch quality. Lab-tested for cannabinoids, terpenes, and microbial safety, it offers versatile performance for topping flower, pipe sessions, or casual dabbing. Discreetly shipped across the EU in cold-chain-protected, odor-proof packaging.

name: Dry Filtered Hash 3X
description:
Dry Filtered Hash 3X
is a premium, triple-refined solventless concentrate crafted for uncompromising purity. Through successive stages of precision dry-screen separation, we isolate only the most mature, resin-dense trichome heads while progressively eliminating plant matter and stalk fragments. The result is an exceptionally clean, sandy-to-pliable blonde resin with bright, true-to-cultivar terpenes and a smooth, full-bodied melt. Zero water, zero solvents, zero additives,  just mechanically purified resin in its most stable, granular form. Lab-tested for potency and contaminants, cured at 58–62% RH, and shipped discreetly across the EU with cold-chain freshness guaranteed.

name: Dry Sift Hash
description:
Dry Sift Hash
is a timeless, solventless concentrate produced by gently tumbling premium cannabis across precision mesh screens to isolate only the purest trichome heads. The result is a sandy-to-pliable, golden resin with bright, flower-true terpenes and virtually no plant matter. Zero water, zero solvents, zero additives, just mechanically separated kief in its most honest, versatile form. Ideal for topping flower, pressing, low-temp dabbing, or collector archiving. Lab-tested for potency, terpenes, and contaminants, and shipped discreetly across the EU in cold-chain-protected, odor-proof packaging.

name: Frozen Sift Hash
description:
Frozen Sift Hash
is a premium, solventless concentrate crafted by mechanically separating trichome heads at sub-zero temperatures to preserve volatile terpenes and prevent contamination. The result is an exceptionally clean, blonde-to-golden kief with bright, true-to-cultivar aromatics and minimal plant matter. Zero solvents, zero water, zero additives,  just pure, cold-preserved resin in a dry, granular, ready-to-use form. Lab-tested for potency, terpenes, and purity, it offers full-flavor dabbing, topping, or collector-grade archiving. Shipped discreetly across the EU in cold-chain-protected, odor-proof packaging.

name: Hashish Eggs Hash
description:
Hashish Eggs Hash
is a heritage-grade, hand-formed solventless resin shaped in the traditional egg or temple-ball style. Crafted through pure mechanical separation and slow curing, it delivers a dense, dark, aromatic profile of deep earth, spice, and roasted wood. Zero solvents, zero additives, just authentic terroir in a collectible format. Lab-tested for purity and potency, shipped discreetly across the EU in cold-chain-protected, odor-proof packaging.

name: LA MOUSSE HASH
description:
La Mousse Hash
is a premium, solventless ice-water concentrate whipped into a pale, airy, cloud-like mousse that crumbles gently between your fingertips. Crafted without heat, pressure, or chemicals, this pliable, moisture-balanced resin preserves the plant’s complete terpene spectrum in its most delicate form. No blade, no mesh pad, no fighting a dense brick, just soft, creamy hash that melts cleanly and doses effortlessly. Cured and stored at 58–62% RH to protect its fragile texture, every batch is lab-tested for potency, terpenes, and purity. Shipped discreetly across the EU in cold-chain-protected, odor-proof packaging.

name: Static Sift Hash
description:
Static Sift Hash
is the pinnacle of mechanical solventless purity, produced using gentle electrostatic separation and precision silkscreen filtration to capture only the ripest, uncontaminated trichome heads. Zero water, zero solvents, zero additives, just dry, sandy-to-pliable blonde resin bursting with bright, true-to-cultivar terpenes. Lab-tested for potency and purity, this collector-grade kief delivers a clean, full-flavored experience with minimal plant matter. Shipped discreetly across the EU with cold-chain freshness guaranteed.
